description: Organize downloads by file type with change previews, undo history and optional automatic sorting.
notes: The published Windows build is a Tauri 2 NSIS setup, not a portable archive. Scoop runs the setup silently and redirects its installation directory to the current Scoop version directory.
The application has its own signed GitHub updater. Disable automatic updates in the application Settings if Scoop is to manage application updates.
Settings and operation history remain outside Scoop under %APPDATA%\com.thonyy.download-organizer and are not removed by Scoop uninstall.
